newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan rains end long drought.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan rains end long drought.

text.p: Heavy rains hit the Kenyan capital Nairobi late on Saturday, ending three months of drought which have been declared a national emergency.
The arrival of the rains in Nairobi followed earlier downpours in parts of western Kenya near Lake Victoria.

The drought, following below-average rainfall in many areas last year, had sharply reduced water levels in many reservoirs. Electricity supplies in Nairobi and other areas are subject to daily cuts to conserve water at hydro-electric generating plants.
Famine relief food supplies are being distributed in areas worst hit by the drought, and thousands of cattle and wild game have already died.

Meteorological officials in Nairobi said there was now a good prospect for further rains in central Kenya, including the capital. The main rains are normally experienced in Kenya in the April-May period.
